mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change) compresses equity valuation multiples by raising discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% (measured as 3-month change exceeding 0.3 percentage points) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% and 3-month change exceeds 0.3pp, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates broad-based consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During supply shock regimes (indicated by 3-month decline in industrial production), corporate margins contract and growth expectations are revised downward, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances during supply shock periods (INDPRO decline > 0.5% over 3 months), or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1400 thousand units (current value 1474.0) signals housing market contraction, reducing consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400.0, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 3.0% compresses real corporate profits and triggers monetary policy tightening expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (year-over-year), or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 110 (current value 112.6889) signals strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 110, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous slowdown in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth is below 0.2% and UNRATE rises above 4.6%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.
